grammar.title: 形容词与副词的比较级&最高级

parts.text: 形容词 与 副词 的比较级、最高级 只有形容词与副词才有比较级和最高级。 变化规则 与动词时态无关，可以用于任何的时态里比较。 比较级的句型结构 介词短语通常放到句子的后面做定语表比较的范围。 表示 范围 的短语

rows: 双写最后一个辅音字母加 er, est
辅音字母加 y 结尾
变 y 为 i,加 er, est

headers: 主语 + 谓语（系）+ 比较级 + than …
主语 + 谓语（系）+ the + 最高级 + 范围
rows: He is cool er than before. 他比以前帅。 She is smart er than before. 她比从前时尚。 He was fast er than any other one.他比其他人都快。

It was the big gest rabbit in the world. 这 曾是 全世界最大的一只兔子。 He is the short est man in the world. 他是全世界最矮的人。 It is the bus iest day in this month. 今天是这个月最忙的一天。 He is the tall est of us all. 他是我们当中个子最高的。

parts.text: in the world 全世界
in China 全中国
in Beijing 全北京
in the(our) class 全班
in a year 一年中
in a season 一季度中
in a month 一个月中
of us all 我们所有人中
of them all 他们所有人中
最高级的范围
Hans is the tall est student in our class .
The day before yesterday was the hot test day in the year .
It is the larg est crowd I have ever seen . 使用句子表范围(定语从句)
The green suitcase is the heav iest of them all .
It is warm today, but it was warmer yesterday.
It is cool today, but it was cooler yesterday.
It is wet today, but it was wetter yesterday.
He's late again today, but he was later yesterday.
This test is easy, but that one is easier .
This bookcase is large, but that one is larger .

expand.title: 比较级&最高级的有用句型

parts.text: East, west, home is best. 金窝银窝，不如自己的草窝。
Facts speak louder than words. 事实胜于雄辩。
Health is better than wealth. 健康高于财富。
It is better to be the head of dog. 宁为鸡头不做凤尾。
The sauce is better than the fish. 喧宾夺主。
There is no best, but better. 没有最好只有更好。
To make the best even better. 没有最好只有更好。 ✓
